title: Leatherneck Lanes
intro: If you love to bowl, Leatherneck Lanes located on Camp Pendleton is right up your alley offering open, league, and glow-in-the-dark bowling.

sections.heading: Amenities
sections.markdown:
- Party, Special Events, Meeting Rooms
- Free Wi-Fi
- Bowling Leagues
- Pool Tables
- Exciting New Scoring System
- Open to the Public (must have base access or sponsorship)

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.markdown:
**Individual Pricing (per game, per bowler)**

| | Tuesday-Thursday | Friday-Saturday |
|---|---|---|
| Adult | $5 / $5.75 | $5.50 / $6.50 |
| Youth | $4 / $5.25 | $4 / $5.25 |

**Per Lane, Per Hour**
- Tuesday-Thursday: $25/hour
- Friday-Saturday: $30/hour

**Other**
- Shoe Rental: $4
- Socks: $2

**Private Party Package**
- Adult – $7 per person, includes 2 hours of bowling and shoes
- 12 and Under – $5 per person, includes 2 hours of bowling and shoes
- No room or decorations included.

**Unit Function**
- $5.50 per person, includes 2 hours of bowling and shoes
- Requires one form of payment by credit card or PO/IBT.

**Room Rental**
- Strike Room – $50 per hour, minimum 2 hours (accommodates 50 guests)
- Spare Room – $40 per hour, minimum 2 hours (accommodates 40 guests)

sections.heading: Birthday Party Packages
sections.markdown:
**Spare Room Party Package – $99**
- 1-hour Spare Room rental with party decor: balloons, plates, napkins, cups, and table covers
- 1 hour of bowling (shoe rental included)
- Up to 10 children
- Birthday child is free

**Strike Room Party Package – $127**
- 1-hour Strike Room rental with party decor: balloons, plates, napkins, cups, and table covers
- 1 hour of bowling (shoe rental included)
- Up to 15 children
- Birthday child is free

**Additional Guests:**
- 12 and Under: $5 per person
- Adult: $7 per person
